name: pasted.add
description: A link pasted onto the moodboard, under the client's id: where it is from, and the idea it would seed. The same paste again keeps one link; an id another brand holds is refused. A picture is an https address or none.
sql: with made as (insert into brandbase.pasted_links as x (id, brand_id, created_at, reference) values (:id, :brand, :now::timestamptz, jsonb_build_object('platform', :platform::text, 'account', :account::text, 'image', :image::text, 'borrow', :borrow::text, 'seed', (select jsonb_object_agg(k, v) from jsonb_each(:seed::jsonb) e(k, v) where k in ('format', 'pillar', 'hook', 'angle', 'feature', 'shots', 'sharper')))) on conflict (id) do update set id = excluded.id where x.brand_id = excluded.brand_id returning x.*) select brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(m)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(m.created_at)) as result from made m
